summary: Backend import system testing completed. PDF sandbox fix verified (13/13 tests pass). Excel worker validated (9/9 tests pass). Critical bug found in import API: Request.form() called with unsupported max_part_size parameter.

critical_bugs.impact: All import creation endpoints fail with TypeError
critical_bugs.details: Starlette 0.37.2 Request.form() only accepts max_files and max_fields parameters, not max_part_size. This breaks all PDF and Excel import uploads.
critical_bugs.error: TypeError: Request.form() got an unexpected keyword argument 'max_part_size'
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Remove max_part_size parameter from request.form() call. Size limits should be enforced by import_guard middleware instead.
